title: Answer: reality is energy plus information

statements.text: The founding axiom of CRFT is $\Phi_R = E + I$: reality equals energy plus information. What is fundamental is a single self-organizing geometric-informational field, of which space, consciousness, action and time are differentiated consequences.

sources.quote: reality is defined by the axiom Phi_R = E + I (Reality = Energy + Information)
the four pillars of reality are simply the differentiated consequences of a single, self-organizing geometric field
